title: ComparisonResult
description: Task 5 — pitch/timing difference between two aligned Signals, and the collapsed 0-100% score for Teach mode. Owned by Person C (signal-processing/compare/). Consumed by Person A/UI for display and by Teach mode's grading flow.

reference_signal_id.description: Which of signal_ids is the reference the other is compared against (e.g. the teacher's Signal in Teach mode).

alignment_method.description: The Task 4 AlignmentResult.method used to produce the correspondence this comparison is built on.

content_matched.description: False when alignment_method is timestamp_offset -- the two signals don't share melodic content (e.g. different material, not the same melody echoed back), so pitch/timing comparison isn't meaningful and the *_deviation/*_accuracy/overall_similarity_score fields are all null.

pitch_deviation_cents.description: Summary stats over aligned, jointly-voiced samples. Null when content_matched is false.

timing_deviation_ms.description: Summary stats over matched note onsets (other's actual onset vs. where the DTW warp trend predicted it). Null when content_matched is false.

pitch_accuracy.description: clamp(100 - mean_abs_pitch_deviation_cents, 0, 100) -- a full semitone (100 cents) off zeroes this out. Null when content_matched is false.

timing_accuracy.description: clamp(100 - mean_abs_timing_deviation_ms / 2, 0, 100) -- 200ms of onset drift zeroes this out. Null when content_matched is false.

overall_similarity_score.description: Resolved formula: 0.7 * pitch_accuracy + 0.3 * timing_accuracy. Null when content_matched is false.
